sections.summary: REPLACE: Plain-language summary with the key information on the issuer, the token, holder rights, principal risks, and the redemption procedure. Art. 19 Abs. 6 MiCAR requires the summary warnings and a statement that holders have a right of redemption at any time, with the conditions for redemption; the linter expects at least 80 words.
sections.risk_warning: REPLACE: The mandatory statement under Art. 19 Abs. 4 MiCAR — the token may lose its value in part or in full, may not always be transferable, may not be liquid, and is not covered by investor-compensation or deposit-guarantee schemes.
sections.management_statement: REPLACE: Statement of the management body that the white paper complies with Title III MiCAR and that the information is fair, clear, and not misleading (Art. 19 Abs. 5 MiCAR). The linter checks key terms only.
sections.notification_date: REPLACE: Date of notification of the white paper (Art. 19 Abs. 7 MiCAR).
sections.language: REPLACE: State the language of the white paper and why it satisfies Art. 19 Abs. 8 MiCAR (official language of the home Member State or a language customary in international finance).
sections.issuer: REPLACE: Legal form, registered seat, register number, governance, and management-body experience of the issuer (Anhang II Teil A MiCAR for ARTs).
sections.art: REPLACE: Description of the asset-referenced token, the reference assets, and the stabilisation mechanism.
sections.offer_or_admission: REPLACE: Terms of the offer to the public or admission to trading — addressees, price, subscription mechanics, target market.
sections.rights_and_obligations: REPLACE: Rights and obligations of the holder (Anhang II Teil D MiCAR), including the permanent right of redemption under Art. 39 Abs. 1 MiCAR and its treatment in insolvency, complaint procedures, and any transfer restrictions.
sections.technology: REPLACE: Description of the underlying technology — consensus mechanism, smart contract governance, custody of keys, audits.
sections.risks: REPLACE: Principal risks — market, credit, liquidity, de-peg, operational, and regulatory risk, plus the reserve-impairment cure procedure.
sections.reserve_of_assets: REPLACE: Composition, custody, segregation, valuation, and audit of the reserve of assets (Anhang II Teil G, Art. 36 and 37 MiCAR).
sections.environmental_impact: REPLACE: Principal adverse impacts on the climate of the consensus mechanism, per the ESMA sustainability-indicator RTS.
sections.redemption: REPLACE: Redemption policy under Art. 39 Abs. 2 MiCAR — redemption in funds other than e-money equivalent to the market value of the referenced assets, or by delivery of those assets; how and when, whether any fee applies (none under Art. 39 Abs. 3 MiCAR, without prejudice to Art. 46), and under which conditions redemption may be suspended (Art. 46 MiCAR).
